cohort.definition: Official GT edges whose two endpoints are matched by the patched scorer to original raw FrameDet nodes in adjacent frames. FN membership comes from the exact baseline topology; 10um cohorts use pre-smoothing raw FrameDet geometry.

e1_distance_rank.decision_rule: PASS only if rank<=10 fraction is >=0.90 for both all official GT edges and the newly derived above-10um baseline FN cohort.
e1_distance_rank.interpretation: PASS: replace the metric-only gate with a reviewed top-k standalone change.

e2_motion_recentring.interpretation: FAIL at the explicit primary >=50% convention for 'large fraction'; do not implement re-gating.
e2_motion_recentring.prediction_contract: Exact bh_graph formula: predicted=source when no incoming adjacent edge, else source+0.5*(source-parent), on raw FrameDet coordinates.
